biography.education: B.S. Kinesiology UT Austin 1992; M.D. UTMB Galveston 1997
biography.career: Oculoplastic surgeon. Lake Travis ISD School Board (2012-2015). Texas State Senator SD-24 (2017-2023) — first Republican from Travis County in modern era. Texas Land Commissioner (Jan 2023-present) — first woman in Texas history. GLO manages 13M acres, Permanent School Fund (~$57B), Veterans Land Board, Alamo, coastal protection, disaster recovery.
biography.primaryResult: Ran unopposed in Republican primary March 3, 2026
biography.generalOpponent: Benjamin Flores (D) — Bay City Councilman, cybersecurity professional

policyPositions.position: Pro-oil-and-gas as primary energy and economic driver. Manages fossil fuel leasing on 13M acres of state land. Supports carbon sequestration and nuclear as revenue supplements — NOT framed as climate action. Secured world's largest carbon sequestration lease (1.2M acres, $130M for PSF, projected $10B over decade).
GLO contributed nearly $6B to public education through oil/gas revenues and carbon sequestration into PSF. Record $4.8B PSF distribution for 2026-27.

Jocelyn Initiative (Nov 2024): committed GLO resources for detention/deportation; offered 1,402 acres in Starr County for deportation facilities and border wall staging. Blocked Biden from disposing border wall materials.
Increased VLB home loan limit to $832,750; added lenders; disbursed $1B+ to 4,100+ veterans.
'Never allowed unless life of mother in jeopardy.' Co-authored SB 8 (heartbeat act). Supported HB 1280 (trigger law). Texas Alliance for Life endorsed 2026.
NRA endorsed 2022 citing 'nearly two dozen pro-gun bills.' Early supporter of constitutional carry (HB 1927).
'Medicaid and Medicare should remain available, but no other taxpayer-funded programs are necessary' (2022 iVoterGuide).
2023 Coastal Resiliency Master Plan: 121 projects; $84.6M CEPRA funds. Framed as disaster prep, not climate adaptation.
Oversaw $5.7B Hurricane Harvey recovery. Launched 2024 Disasters programs ($287M).

votingRecord.conservatismRanking: 13th most conservative TX Senator (2019 Rice); 8th most conservative (2021 Rice)

positionConflicts.conflict: Manages world's largest carbon sequestration lease and invests in coastal resilience (actions that objectively reduce emissions), but frames entirely in revenue/economic terms, never climate terms. Simultaneously champions oil/gas as primary mission. Actions = pragmatic revenue maximization, not climate ideology.
Offered GLO land for deportation facilities — novel use of land management authority beyond traditional mission.
